aiSummary.oneLiner: An extensive directory aggregating projects and products built by independent Chinese software developers.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: This repository serves as a centralized, community-driven directory showcasing projects created by independent Chinese developers. It meticulously categorizes hundreds of applications, websites, and games, distinguishing between active, launched, and deprecated projects. The primary goal is to foster transparency and inspiration within the developer community by providing a structured index of side projects and indie businesses. By maintaining clear submission guidelines and distinct sections for different types of applications, it acts as a comprehensive discovery platform for indie hackers and users interested in independent software.
keyFeatures: Comprehensive aggregation: Collects and categorizes a vast array of applications, websites, and games from Chinese independent developers.
Lifecycle tracking: Clearly marks the status of each project using icons to indicate if it is in development, launched, or abandoned.
Structured categorizations: Separates projects into logical sub-boards, such as programmer tools and games, for easier navigation and discovery.
Community driven submissions: Relies on pull requests and issues for developers to submit and update their own projects organically.
Historical archiving: Maintains dedicated archives for older projects to ensure long-term visibility and historical tracking of the indie ecosystem.
